The restaurant has a relaxed, welcoming vibe with authentic country music playing in the background, adding to its old-Goa charm. There's ample parking, making it convenient even during busy hours. The service is warm, attentive, and genuinely hospitable.

We ordered the Goan fish curry with rice, Chicken Cafreal, and a crispy fried fish. The fish curry was rich, flavourful, and perfectly balanced with coconut and spices, paired beautifully with fluffy steamed rice. The Chicken Cafreal was the star of the meal—marinated in the traditional green herb and spice paste, tender, juicy, and packed with bold, authentic flavours without being overwhelmingly spicy. The fried fish was wonderfully crisp on the outside while remaining fresh and succulent inside.

What stands out is that the food tastes homemade rather than commercial. The recipes stay true to Goan culinary traditions, using fresh ingredients and local spices. The portions are generous, and every dish feels thoughtfully prepared.

Like most restaurants in Goa, they serve beer and wine, making it easy to enjoy a leisurely meal. Another pleasant surprise was the pricing. Considering the quality, quantity, and authenticity of the food, Cota Cozinha is very reasonably priced and offers excellent value for money.

It's easy to understand why so many diners recommend this place. Regulars often praise its consistently fresh seafood, authentic Goan recipes, friendly staff, quick service, and relaxed atmosphere. After our visit, we couldn't agree more.

If you're looking to enjoy genuine Goan flavours away from the usual tourist traps, Cota Cozinha is a fantastic choice. Delicious food, warm hospitality, relaxed ambience, and pocket-friendly prices make it a place you'll want to return to.
